author_note: Written blind from only the 13 contracts in workflows/*.yaml and scripts/workflow_registry.py of the netzoo-h6-run worktree; no other file, log, test set or code was opened and no model was called. Each gold follows from contract text quoted in its evidence field. do: every input, sample/feature count and setting in the prompt is a declared input or control within its stated range/allowed values and meets every stated minimum or limit. dont: exactly one quotable condition fails (a setting combination, a value range, an unregistered method or handoff, a setting not exposed, an input the workflow does not take, a size limit or relation), or the result is one no contract produces (registry statements on clustering from expression, CONDOR comparing two networks, GIRAFFE's absolute TF activity). ask: the user states uncertainty about one fact and both branches were worked through to different contract outcomes; LIONESS-DRAGON value counts were computed both over all feature pairs and over cross-layer pairs only, and both give the same gold. vague: in-scope data with no concrete result. file_checkable is true only for ask items whose deciding fact sits in a named input file. Evidence quotes were machine-checked as substrings of the source files after whitespace collapsing and joining of Python string-literal continuations. Items were written grouped by class and form, then ids were assigned after a fixed-seed shuffle so the class cannot be read from id order.

items.reason: Size limit: 3,500 features give 6,123,250 pairs x 50 samples = 306,162,500 per-sample values (150,000,000 even for cross-layer pairs only), above the 20,000,000 limit.
